line_items.reasoning: Q3 revenue of $13.3B came in above the midpoint of $13.0B and in the upper half of the $12.5B–$13.5B guided range, clearly exceeding the midpoint guidance.

Non-GAAP gross margin collapsed to ~18% in Q3, catastrophically below the guided ~38%, driven by ~$3B in noncash impairment and accelerated depreciation charges that alone reduced gross margin by ~2,300 bps; even adjusting for those charges, Lunar Lake's in-package memory architecture is adding further structural margin pressure into 2025.
The ~$3B in noncash impairment/depreciation charges reduced EPS by ~$0.61/share, implying reported non-GAAP EPS came in well below the guided -$0.03, representing a significant miss versus guidance.

No specific Q3 CapEx figures were reported in the current quarter results that would indicate a clear deviation from the guided 2024 gross CapEx of $25B–$27B or 2025 targets of $20B–$23B, so this is treated as inline.

While OpEx reduction efforts appear on track, the $15.6B in GAAP charges (including ~$10B deferred tax asset impairment, $2.6B Mobileye goodwill impairment, and $2.2B severance), combined with adjusted free cash flow expected to remain negative for full-year 2024, represent significant negative outcomes beyond what was guided; additionally, Gaudi 3 revenue will fall well short of the $500M 2024 target.
